essential_tweet_embeddings.tweet_text: Every “utterance” (status, tweet, whatever) is a bit of an invitation, a bit of a proposal. “Let’s play this game”. When strangers read the proposal accurately, and support the game, a shared understanding develops. You can make friends this way.

*Everything else* can be determined from this question. Your ethics, beliefs, actions, habits...
